description: Send a message to the AI agent at a fone.me link and get its reply — ask a question, request a booking or a quote, or leave a message for the person. The conversation continues across calls. Say who you're asking for in on_behalf_of.

link.description: A fone.me link or name, e.g. 'fone.me/samspearin'.

message.description: What to say to the agent.

on_behalf_of.description: The name of the person you're asking for (shown to the owner).

name: message_agent
title: Message a fone.me agent
